styleLock.backgroundSystem: sunny outdoor scenes with matte white walls and warm wood decks for lifestyle shots; clean white #FFFFFF and warm sand beige #F2EFEA seamless panels for detail, spec and trust shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright natural sunlight with crisp soft shadows, warm 5200K feel in scenes; soft diffused high-key with controlled highlights in detail shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: warm wood planks, matte textured white wall, light grey paving stone, flat neutral fabric-friendly panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; marigold banner strips with charcoal text; consistent rounded rectangular info labels
styleLock.iconSystem: circular numbered markers 01/02/03 with marigold accent bars, thin-line icons only
styleLock.presentationRules: child model full-body in scene shots with face angled away; garment flat or macro in detail shots; stable scale and centered garment placement
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm playful kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm sand beige #F2EFEA, marigold yellow accent #F5A623 and charcoal black #2B2B2B; bright natural sunlight with crisp soft shadows around 5200K in scenes and soft diffused high-key in detail shots; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels with circular numbered markers and marigold accent bars; consistent thin-line icon style; clean lifestyle kids fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable child-model scale in scene shots and stable garment scale in detail shots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
